Consult Summary:
- 23-year-old woman with 3–4 days of constant, worsening lower abdominal (suprapubic/central) pain rated 8/10, associated with light pink vaginal bleeding post-menses and nausea without vomiting.
- Sexually active; etonogestrel implant in situ ~1 year; last intercourse 4 days ago; LMP 2–3 weeks ago; last pregnancy test 1 month ago. Plan for face-to-face exam and same-day pregnancy test; seek urgent care if symptoms worsen or test positive.

Problem List:

Issue 1:
- Lower abdominal pain with light vaginal bleeding
  - Onset/duration: Started a few days ago; worsening over time; constant.
  - Location: Midline lower abdomen, below the umbilicus.
  - Severity: 8/10.
  - Associated symptoms: Nausea (no vomiting). Small amount of light pink vaginal bleeding after normal period 2–3 weeks ago; minor additional vaginal discharge. Constipation last week (now resolved).
  - Pertinent negatives: No fever/feverishness (no thermometer), no dyspnea, no shoulder pain, no syncope on standing, no urinary pain/odor/frequency, no current diarrhea.
  - Gynecologic/sexual: Sexually active; last intercourse 4 days ago. Etonogestrel implant (Implanon) placed ~1 year ago. Periods present but irregular. Last period reported as normal.
  - Obstetric history: No prior pregnancies.
  - Clinical impression: Undifferentiated lower abdominal pain with intermenstrual bleeding; pregnancy status unknown.

Issue 2:
- Pregnancy status unknown in a reproductive-age patient with abdominal pain and bleeding
  - Last pregnancy test performed ~1 month ago (before current pain).
  - Contraception: Etonogestrel implant in situ (~1 year).
  - Plan includes same-day pregnancy test due to current symptoms.

Issue 3:
- Recent constipation (resolved)
  - Last week: Constipated for about a week.
  - Current week: Bowel movements returned to usual; no ongoing issues reported.

Medications:
- Etonogestrel implant (Implanon), subdermal contraceptive in situ ~1 year; dose not documented.
- No other medications mentioned.

Allergies:
- Amoxicillin.

Past Medical History:
- No prior surgeries reported.
- No previous pregnancies.

Social History:
- Occupation: School teacher.
- Living situation: Lives with husband and husband’s family.
- Tobacco: Not documented/unclear.
- Alcohol: Not documented/unclear.
- Recreational drugs: Denies.
- Travel: Abroad about 1 year ago; none recent.

Preventative History:
- Not documented.

Physical Examination:
- Vitals: Not recorded.
- Examination: None performed (telehealth consult).

Plan:
- Arrange face-to-face clinic visit for examination (abdominal assessment; further evaluation as indicated).
- Perform a pregnancy test today; if positive, contact clinic immediately for urgent assessment.
- Safety net: Seek urgent care sooner if pain worsens significantly, if unable to keep fluids down, or if new concerning symptoms develop.
- Patient to call support line to schedule the in-person appointment.

Quality checks:
- Missing expected elements: Full medication list and reconciliation; smoking and alcohol history; vitals; physical examination; pelvic exam; urinalysis; STI risk assessment/testing; pain management advice; immunization and preventive care history.
- Internal conflicts: Age stated as 23; year of birth stated as 1996—alignment not verified (conflict noted).
- Transcript quality: Several unclear/inaudible segments and interruptions; some responses ambiguous.
